statements.t: In upcoming years, we plan to expand our business rapidly by increasing the number of business managers, vendors and SKUs.

Our proprietary repricing tool analyzes sales trends, projected sales, inventory age, inventory cost, potential profits, Fulfillment by Amazon (“FBA”) fees, competing offers, and seasonality and determines an urgency level.

Policy for inventory allowance: The Company writes down the cost of obsolete and slow-moving inventories to the estimated net realizable value, based on inventory obsolescence trends, historical experience, forecasted consumer demand and application of the specific identification method.
Revenues are measured as the amount of consideration for which the Company expects to be entitled in exchange for transferring goods.
Deferred tax assets are evaluated for future realization and reduced by a valuation allowance to the extent the Company believe they will not be realized.
As routine work shifts to AI, our teams are freed to focus on higher-value decisions, and we believe this will allow us to scale the business without growing headcount at the same pace.”
The Company continues to expect 2026 net income to be in the range of $0.75 million to $1.5 million.
